result_scope.endpoint: Composite of operative mortality or cardiovascular death during follow-up
result_scope.measurement: Operative mortality (death during or within 30 days after surgery) or death from cardiovascular causes during follow-up, adjudicated by an independent clinical-events committee.
result_scope.time_window: From randomization through follow-up until four years after the last patient was enrolled; median follow-up was 6.2 years in early surgery and 6.1 years in conservative care.
result_scope.population: All randomized participants in the comparison groups

reported_result.analysis_population: All randomized patients in an intention-to-treat analysis: 73 assigned to early surgery and 72 assigned to conservative care.

endpoint.name: Primary end point: operative mortality or death from cardiovascular causes during follow-up

slots.name: reported_result
slots.value: comparative_effect | Primary end point: operative mortality or death from cardiovascular causes during follow-up | Hazard ratio

propositions.name: document_availability
propositions.proposition: A plan or SAP describing the approved Result is available in the captured Sources.

propositions.name: plan_applicability
propositions.proposition: Compare the selected reported analysis with the applicable planned analysis for the exact comparison, cohort, endpoint, population, window, and effect measure. Keep their source citations together with any evidence about a change's timing and reason. Matching endpoint or population and an early plan do not resolve a material analysis difference. A documented change before unblinded access or clearly unrelated to results may qualify; an unknown amendment or a different method label alone establishes neither correspondence nor noncorrespondence.

propositions.name: chronology
propositions.proposition: Plan finalization preceded access to unblinded outcome data.

propositions.name: eligible_measurements
propositions.proposition: The eligible outcome measurements and the reported subset are known.

propositions.name: eligible_analyses
propositions.proposition: The eligible analyses and the reported analysis are known.

propositions.name: measurement_selection
propositions.proposition: The reported measurement was selected because of its result; inspected report methods/results or companion reports may establish this without a protocol.

propositions.name: results_based_selection
propositions.proposition: The reported analysis was selected because of its result; inspected report methods/results or companion reports may establish this without an SAP.

paired_examples.changed_premise: whether the located plan covers the approved Result
left_facts: The SAP names the approved comparison, cohort, endpoint, window, population, analysis, and effect measure.
right_facts: A platform master plan names a different cohort and intervention phase.
paired_examples.reasoning_focus: Assess plan applicability before using its dates or content for chronology.

paired_examples.changed_premise: whether reporting choice depended on the result
left_facts: The SAP lists three eligible analyses. All three were conducted, but only the adjusted model was reported. Dated correspondence made before unblinded results confirms that reporting plan.
right_facts: The SAP lists the same three eligible analyses. All three were conducted, but only the adjusted model was reported. Dated minutes after unblinding state it was chosen because its estimate was favorable and the other two were withheld.
paired_examples.reasoning_focus: Hold the eligible analyses and reporting pattern fixed; inspect the evidence about why the reporting decision was made.

paired_examples.changed_premise: whether unblinded access preceded the amendment
left_facts: Amended SAP signed June 15; cutoff and lock were August 1.
right_facts: Amended SAP signed June 15; cutoff and lock were August 1.
paired_examples.reasoning_focus: Compare access with amendment timing; chronology alone does not establish result-driven selection.

paired_examples.changed_premise: whether the timing of unblinded access is known
left_facts: Applicable SAP signed June 15. Enrollment ended May 1.
The reports do not identify when investigators accessed unblinded results.
right_facts: The same applicable SAP signed June 15. Enrollment ended May 1.
A dated report confirms investigators accessed unblinded results May 15.
paired_examples.reasoning_focus: Unknown timing is not proof of late finalization. Establish the negative chronology premise separately; neither branch proves results-driven choice.

paired_examples.changed_premise: whether the report establishes why a subset was reported
left_facts: No protocol or SAP is captured. Article methods identify three eligible analyses. Results report one; the reporting reason is unresolved.
right_facts: No protocol or SAP is captured. The same article methods identify three eligible analyses. The authors state that only the favorable estimate was reported after comparing the three results.
paired_examples.reasoning_focus: Keep plan availability and alternatives fixed. Preserve direct evidence of results-driven choice; missing plan chronology does not erase it.

paired_examples.changed_premise: where the same signed analysis plan is packaged
left_facts: Plan covers the same cohort, endpoint, window, population, and analysis.
right_facts: Plan covers the same cohort, endpoint, window, population, and analysis.
Plan is a separate repository PDF.
paired_examples.reasoning_focus: Find the plan by scope and chronology; packaging does not change its content.

prompt: Compare result_scope (target), reported_result, and target_relation. Retain scope differences; assess the reported Result. Read reported_result, analysis_plan, correspondence, amendment, and unblinded_access together: locate the selected and planned methods in their cited passages, then evidence about whether, when, and why a material change was made. Keep unresolved method correspondence explicit even when plan timing is well supported. Distinguish method content from labels; a discrepancy does not establish results-based selection. target or analyzed populations do not establish observed outcomes. Classify remaining propositions; do not infer causation, availability, censoring, measurement influence, plan correspondence, or risk from metadata, arithmetic, or wording alone. An empty passage group is unopened; inspect relevant Sources before recording an information limitation.
